pitch_pack.body_template:
Hi {first_name},

Quick note from Steven — I build production AI agents for companies that want measurable workflow wins (not slide decks). I've been mapping where AI quietly takes hours out of HR ops: req-to-offer routing, screening pre-pass, onboarding workflow generation, candidate comms, headcount-plan modeling. Most of it isn't a new tool — it's an agent sitting on top of whatever you already run (Workday, Greenhouse, Lattice, etc.).

If you're open to it, I'd run a free 30-min audit of one HR workflow at {company} — your pick — and walk you through what I'd ship, what it'd save, and what it'd cost. No deck. Actual mockups against your real flow.

Proof I ship production AI, not slideware:
• Spirit Library — live iOS app, 1,700+ recipes, autonomous agents running it 24/7 (https://spiritlibrary.app)
• 4 Seasons Organic — full ops calendar + drag-to-reschedule for an NYC cleaner (https://4seasons-ops.vercel.app)
• Supreme Seams — 24/7 AI lead capture for an auto shop (https://supreme-seams.com)

Open to 30 min on Zoom this week or next?

Best,
Steven Samori
Smore Labs · AI Advisory
P.S. This note was drafted by my AI co-pilot and reviewed by me before send — it's also the demo.

—
One-time intro. Reply 'unsubscribe' and you're off the list immediately.
Smore Labs Inc · Westchester County, NY

demo_gate.comment: No per-lead Vercel demo for HR — pitch leads with shipped portfolio links instead. Reconsider if a hot lead asks for a tailored proof.

cadence.comment: 5 days instead of 4 — F500 HR inboxes are slow; don't crowd.

rate_limits.comment: Start very conservative. F500 + HR is brand-sensitive; one bad batch tarnishes the sender. Ramp only after first batch lands a reply or week 2 with zero complaints.

opt_out.comment: Shares the global suppression list. The body template already carries the soft CAN-SPAM footer.

state.comment: SHARED with claudesonnet111 + axon auto-sender. One pacing envelope across all three lanes from this Gmail.

approval.comment: Gated until Steven approves the first canary batch. Flip to true once drafts look right.

pricing_disclosure_policy.comment: Soft-ask pitch loses if rate hits before value. If recipient asks 'how much?' in reply, drafter quotes $1,000/hr advisory and offers a fixed-fee build alternative.
